notes: Half-rack width, 2RU height unit (8.64 x 10.59 x 3.31 in) — rackUnits omitted since it's a half-rack-width device, not a standard full-width rack chassis. Rear panel diagram labels the HDMI monitor out as "HDMI 2.0" but the detailed spec text (Video Input/Output sections) explicitly states "HDMI v1.4a" for both HDMI inputs and outputs — graded all HDMI ports hdmi-1.4 per the authoritative spec text, not the diagram callout (flagging this discrepancy). Front panel has 4x USB 3.2 Gen 1 (5Gbps) Type-A slots for recording media; a 5th identical USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A port is on the rear (USB Slot 5), also used for media, graded usb-5g (backward compatible with USB 2.0/3.0). Two 4-pin XLR power inputs are redundant/parallel DC inputs (12-18VDC, fed by included AC-to-DC adapters), modeled as xlr4-dc, no grade. 2x REF BNC connectors are looping/non-terminating genlock reference (not SDI signal ports) — connector bnc, no grade. LTC timecode input is carried via the Analog Audio XLR In R connector (not a separate physical port) — not modeled as a separate port. Headphone output is a 3.5mm stereo unbalanced jack (trs-3.5). Source: AJA official spec sheet PDF (https://www.aja.com/products/ki-pro-go2/spec-sheet.pdf), cross-checked against product page https://www.aja.com/products/ki-pro-go2.
